records.text: BYU lacrosse head coach Matt Schneck said Tyler Clancy used leadership, personality and humor to create strong relationships and lead teammates on and off the field.
records.speaker: Matt Schneck

appearances.snippet: Elsewhere, it tells us that Clancy (Tyler Clancy)'s reputation for community leadership was mirrored by the leadership role that he earned on the BYU lacrosse team, said Matt Schneck, head coach of BYU men's lacrosse team. ...
